provenance.candidateCommitPolicy: Record the Git HEAD label; require valid/stable group commit and exact pinned source content. Candidate may be committed after freezing without changing these source bytes.
provenance.controlCommitPolicy: Must equal the pinned current PR control HEAD.

contract.scope: Contract only; no new runtime/benchmark observation or old failed acceptance reversal.

originalDecisionUnchanged.reason: The combined prototypes fail the preimplementation-frozen late-game improvement gates against both the frozen population and contemporaneous controls. Matched paired CPU/p50/p99 reductions are 8.34%/8.04%/9.11%, requiring 11%/11%/10%. Overridden paired p99 improves 3.72%, requiring 12%. Passing stock, RSS, write, capacity and correctness guards does not override failed improvement gates.
originalDecisionUnchanged.retainedChanges: Matched/override name-mode benchmark support, expanded source manifests, the existing performance document and retained evidence. No production rule, persistence, projection, protocol or ADR change.
originalDecisionUnchanged.windowDecision: No window-only archive materialization was implemented. The diagnostic observes 241,516 off-window packet-copy occurrences in the baseline and zero in the combined candidate. No independent remaining allocation benefit is demonstrated; scans and wrapper arrays remain, and hidden-event workloads may differ.

mainRuntime.restart: Isolated ports 5375/5373 via restart-local. The initial remote asset metadata connection timed out; retry succeeded using the immutable Viewer built by the first attempt.
mainRuntime.commands: Both late-workload name modes preserve the full baseline Frame hash chain and commit classifications. The override mode was checked after the successful restart.

prototype.archive: Isolated restart and health/frontend checks; full late matched smoke; 43 focused tests; server types; changed-file lint.
prototype.names: Isolated restart and health/frontend checks; full late matched smoke; 57 focused tests plus 2 Worker cases; server/app types; changed-file lint.
prototype.combined: Isolated restart; four complete exact-trace cases; 54 focused tests; real Room history paging, undo, cancellation and rename/reconnect browser test. The browser test passed after setting ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION_POLICY=open on the isolated test service; the initial onboarding failure is retained. No candidate full-fast run because performance gates failed.

verification.build: No main application build for retained benchmark/documentation-only changes. restart-local built the immutable Replay Viewer as its normal prerequisite.
verification.architectureAndADR: Reviewed: unchanged contracts and rejected production prototypes require no architecture or ADR edits.

commands.archiveDiagnostic: python3 run-population.py archive archive --count 3 --cases late-matched late-override
commands.namesDiagnostic: python3 run-population.py names names --count 3 --cases late-matched late-override
commands.pairedTiming: python3 run-pairs.py; 40 sequential processes, with control/candidate order alternating by pair index. Other task apps, tests and diagnostics are stopped during timing.
commands.exact: python3 run-exact.py baseline baseline; python3 run-exact.py names names --cases late-matched late-override; python3 run-exact.py candidate final. compare-exact.py checks complete rows; assembly additionally streams full-file byte equality.
commands.windowDiagnostic: node --import tsx diagnose-window.ts <tree> <absolute-4p-late-fixture> <output.json> matched; run under the same cgroup. Extra full-view calls invalidate timing; no timing values are retained.
commands.writes: ROOM_PERFORMANCE_TRACE=1 systemd-run --user --scope --quiet -p CPUQuota=200% -p MemoryMax=2G strace -f -yy -e trace=pwrite64,write,writev -o <trace.log> node --import tsx scripts/bench/room-performance.ts run <fixtureDir> <report.json>. fixtureDir contains unchanged stock two-player as 2p.json and late four-player as 4p.json. Parse with scripts/bench/room-write-trace.ts.
commands.capacity: node --import tsx scripts/bench/late-game-capacity.ts --fixture scripts/bench/fixtures/room-performance/4p-late.json --output <report.json> --rooms 30 --warmup-seconds 1 --duration-seconds 60 --action-rate 0.45125 --names override; run under the same cgroup.
commands.localVerification: ./restart-local.sh with isolated directories/ports; health/frontend checks and full CLI smoke; pnpm test:fast; pnpm run lint; pnpm exec tsc -p scripts/bench/tsconfig.performance.json
commands.reproduction: Use baseline 32f49e42 or combined prototype da0638cc in isolated worktrees, then copy the exact benchmark harness from this retained change. Tool source, fixture hashes, raw reports and complete prototype patch are embedded. The prototype is not adopted.
